domain: All episodes retain original serial dependency order;only within-episode R versus S may overlap.
No earlier release outside an episode,no cross-layer or cross-iteration overlap/fusion.
Measured services R,S,M are fixed,including waits already inside R;changing collective readiness invalidates those service constants.
Original output and quantization semantics retained;merge waits for both branches.
Outside episode serial segments/gaps remain fixed;relaxation optimistically permits zero internal gaps and no resource contention.
Input/alias/last-reader/ownership/numerical legality must hold independently;this analysis does not supply them.
proof: Each episode requires at least max(R,S)+M. Serial composition with fixed outside segments gives Gnew >= Gold - sum(episodeSpan-max(R,S)-M). This derives a lower bound by relaxation,not from an exhibited schedule.
